custom_expected:
Step 3: Deposit action is NOT visible for user A.
Step 6: Deposit action IS visible for user B.
Step 7: Deposit is successfully recorded against the work order. [VIU: confirm exact action label — 'Deposits', 'Take Deposit', 'Collect Deposit' — and the exact placement in the WO UI].
custom_preconds: See Financial Data ON. Two test users prepared: (A) Invoicing and Payments View only; (B) Invoicing and Payments Create and Edit ON.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as user A (View only).
2. Open a work order in 'Estimate' or 'In progress' state.
3. Look for a 'Take Deposit' / 'Collect Deposit' / 'Deposits' action.
4. Log in as user B (Create and Edit).
5. Open the same kind of work order.
6. Look for and click the deposit action.
7. Enter a deposit amount and confirm.
title: Collecting 'Deposits' on a work order requires Invoicing and Payments: Create and Edit
